Nordic dorms €30-55 documented; Netto/hot-dog + one smorrebrod; free Nyhavn/Christiania, Tivoli one-off. Fare: momondo cheapest MIA-Europe ticket WAS Copenhagen $469; TAP deal $378 Jan-May — $470 solid

Kotor: Montenegro dorms €10-20 (Old Town Hostel class); Balkan €20-35/day documented; bay walks/ladder of Kotor free, walls ~€15 one-off
